title: Decide whether a LOCAL dispatch through 'cloudflare-sandbox' is wanted, or document that the name is cloud-host-only
body: k4s made 'cloudflare-sandbox' an executor the Workflow-hosted reconciler dispatches through, but a local `ticfac run-epic` whose profile names it is still refused by the Go reconciler's honoured set (internal/cli/executor.go builds only local-subprocess and herdr). That refusal is honest today — the Go build genuinely cannot reach a Cloudflare sandbox — but nothing states the boundary as a decision. Either a later Phase 4 item adds a Go executor that proxies dispatches through a deployment's factory, or internal/cli's refusal should say the name is honoured by the cloud host only, so a profile naming it locally is told where it works.
